question: Can a declared field success pass while adverse effects or costs are explicitly unmeasured?
pre_change_observation: A synthetic cumplido/field assessment with unmeasured adverse_effects and cost passed the validate gate; independent review reproduced acceptance with an object status and annotated text.
rejected_design: Free-text placeholder matching had both misses (absence phrased elsewhere in the sentence) and false positives (measured outcomes mentioning no missing data). It was removed rather than used as evidence of measurement.
negative_controls: unmeasured text in English and Spanish, including mid-sentence text
missing source, date, measurements, metric, unit, value or positive sample size
boolean or string values and nonfinite float values
one incomplete measurement appended after a complete one
positive_controls: structured synthetic zero adverse events and zero cost
unchanged non-field success and non-success verdict behavior
legacy_behavior: An older ledger with accepted free-text field success remains readable but its validate acceptance is withdrawn until a new structured assessment version and current review are recorded. No versioned case contains such a success claim.

verification.global: 1351 passed, 1 xfailed with uv run pytest -q
verification.clean_install: offline installation and uv pip check passed on Python 3.11.15 and 3.12.3
verification.installed_smoke_each_python: 9 phases, 14 CLI commands and 14 MCP tools

limitations: The gate validates declared structure, not source authenticity, observation or causal identification.
One declared measurement does not establish coverage of every actor, stage, harm or approved margin.
All test outcomes are invented fixtures, not field observations.
